info.value: amiSraRe ca ' ityapi kvacit pAWaH . ' yAvayeta jugupsAyAm, miSraRe yOti, banDane . yunIti, ca yunote ca .. ' (Slo. 24) iti devaH .

examples: 'SrIrasIti pArSvena vasAhomaM prayOti' (Apa॰SrO॰7.8.25.4). prayOti Gawwayati, loqayati.
'vizRoH stUpo'sIti karzannivAhavanIyaM prati prastaramapAdatte nodyOti na prayOti' (Apa॰SrO॰2.3.8.5). na prayOti=na purastAt sArayati.
'prayuto na pAtAraH' (grAvARaH). prayutaH=GawwayitAraH. prapUrvasya yOteH kvipi rUpam.
'iti (vapAM) prayOti' (BA॰SrO॰7.14.12). prayOti apanayati utKidati.
'yuvA prayOti karmARi (ni॰4.19). prayOti sammiSrayati avivekitvAt.
'prayuvatI gacCati' (ni॰9.26). '
nakizwaM karmaRA naSanna prayozat (f॰8.31.17). prayozat=pfTakkaroti=ekataH karoti.
'DenuM carantIM prayutAmagopAm' (f॰3.57.1). vA॰saM॰11.75 ityatra prayutAM viyuktAM vrajAd BrazwAmAha.
'rAtriM rAtrimaprayAvam' (aTarva॰19.55.1). aprayAvamiti sAyaRaDftaH pAWaH. aprayAtamiti pAWAntaram. aprayAvam=apracCidyA. iha prayurviSleze vartata ityaBipretaM sAyaRasya.
'svapnaScedanftasya prayotA' (f॰786.6).
'pArSvena vasAhomaM prayOti' (tE0 saM0 6.3.11.57). hotavyAM vasAM prayOti Aloqayati. bODAyanaSrOtasUtre (4.9) pyeza granTaH sTitaH.
'yamunA prayuvatI gacCatIti vA' (ni0 6.26.1). pustake Dftacaro'yaN granTaH, arTo na nirdizwaH. sa nirdiSyate. prayuvatI saMBiSrayantI svAni jalAni.
'sarvARi grAmyARyAraRyAnyAjyena prayutya' (vArAhaSrO0 2.2.4.9). prayutya saMmiSrya.
'svapnaSca nedanftasya prayotA' (f0 7.86.6). pustake nyastapUrvamapIdamarTanirdeSAya punardIyate. prayotA prerayitA. prayoktA.
'yamunA prayuvatI gacCatIti vA praviyutaM gacCatIti vA' (ni॰9.26.1). prayuvatI prakarzeRa svAnyudakAnyABirnadIBirmiSrayantI. praviyutaM stimitaM yaTA syAttaraNgastaTetyarTa iti durgaH.
'apa svasAraM sanutaryuyoti' (f॰1.92.11). apayuyoti=viyOti=viyuNkte. svasAramuzasam.
'janayatyE tvA saMyomi' (vA॰saM॰1.22). miSrayAmItyAha.
'yAmeva mfdaM tatra saMyOti' (Sa॰brA॰6.5.1.3). ukto'rTaH.
'janayatyE tvA saMyOmIti saMyutya' (Apa॰SrO॰1.8.14.5). saMyutya=pizwamapaSca melayitvA.
'praRItABirhavIMzi saMyOti' (Sa॰brA॰). praRItApAtrasTABiradDiH puroqASapizwaM melayati.
'saMyadojo yuvate viSvamABiH' (f॰5.32.10). saMyuvate=saMyunakti.
'na ca kAYcana kAYcanasadmacitiM na kapiH SiKinA SiKinA samayOt' (Bawwi॰10.5). samayOt=samayojayat=samabaDnAt.
'mudA sayuhi kAkutsTam' (Bawwi॰20.16). ukto'rTaH.
aSvaM raTaraSmisaMyutam (raGu॰3.42). saMyutam=saMyuktam.
'saM samidyuvase vfzannagne viSvAnyarya A' (tE0 saM0 2.6.11.4). saMyuvase rASI karozi (BakteByaH pradAtum).
'iti navanItena pARI pralipya sarvAnkeSAnsamprayOti' (vA0 gf0 16.7). samprayOti=sampiRqayati=saMhatAn karoti.
'avayuvatI' (ni0 4.11). viyuYjAne.
'yayoranyA'GAni dvezAMsyavayAvayati' (ni0 9.42.1). avayAvayati avamiSrayati, apanayati, parAkaroti, apAkaroti.
'niryuvARo aSastIH' (f0 4.48.2). niryuvARaH pfTak kurvARaH=apAkurvan.
'niryuvARo aSastIrniryutvA~ indrasAraTiH' (f0 4.48.2). apanayannityarTaH.
'vi koSaM maDyamaM yuva' (f0 9.108.9). viyuva=viyuhi=visinu=udGAwaya.
'na ma indreRa saKyaM vi yozat' (f0 2.18.8).
'ihEva staM mA vi yOzwam' (f0 10.85.42). mA viyOzwaM viyuktO mA sma BUtam.
'na sa rAyA SaSamAno vi yozat' (f0 4.2.9). ukto'rTaH.
'aDA sa vIrErdaSaBirvi yUyAH' (f0 7.104.15). viyUyAH=viyUyAt. puruzavyatyayaH. viyuto vipfkto viyukto BUyAdityarTaH.
'iheha vatsErviyutA yadAsan' (f0 5.30.10). viyutA viprayuktAH.
'na vayaM rAyaspozeRa viyOzma' (vA0 saM0 4.22). asakfduktacaro'rTaH. loke yOtirudAttaH, tena mA viyAvizmeti syAt.
'aSezErviyutaM dozEraSezEH saMyutaM guREH' (bf0 Slo0 saM0 5.128). viyutaM viyuktam.
'anyonyaM sma vyatiyutaH SabdASabdEstu BIzaRAn' (Bawwi0 8.6). vyatiyutaH=miSrayataH. anyonyam anyo'nyasya.
'yuktaH sarvEH padBiH samamAyute' (Sa0 brA0 13.2.7.6) samamAyute sAkaM karzati.
'viSvasya yo mana Ayuyuve' (f0 1.138.1). Ayuyuve Akarzati harati Izwe.
'sa (pavamAnaH) maDva Ayuvate vevijAnaH' (f0 9.77.2). Ayuvate Adatte.
'A jAyA yuvate patim' (f0 1.105.2).
'A raSmIn deva yuvase svaSvaH' (tE0 brA0 2.7.16.2). raSmInAyuvase pragrahAnyacCasi.
'rAyaspozaM tvamasmaByaM gavAM kulmiM jIvasa Ayuvasva' (tE0 saM0 2.4.5.2). Ayuvasva dehi, vitara pradiSa.
'A svamadma yuvamAnaH' (f0 1.58.2). AyuvamAna AdadAnaH, gahlAnaH.
'vayAMsi samAsaM pakzAvAyuvAnAni patanti' (Sa0 brA0 4.1.2.26). AyuvAnAni vistArayanti. AyAmayanti.
'siMhaSArdUlamAtaNgavarAharkzamfgAyutaM vanam' (BA0 64.39). AyutaM yuktam AcitaM nicitam.
'AyutaM pitFRAm' (E0 brA0 1.3). vilInArDamAyutaM tu navanItaM yato Gftam iti zaqguruSizyodDftaH SlokAMSaH.
'AyuzA vE devA asurAnAyuvata' (paYca0 brA0 16.3.2). Ayuvata Ayuvan vyayojayan.
'AjyaM vE devAnAM suraBiGftaM manuzyARAmAyutaM pitFRAM navanItaM garBARAm' (E0 brA0 1.3). AyutamIzad vilInam.
'BojanaM nyatraye yuyotam.' (f0 7.68.5). niyuyotam prApayatam (atrim).
'rayi ni vAjaM SrutyaM yuvasva' (f0 7.5.9). ukto'rTaH.
'tasmE SatrUn ni svazwrAnyuvati hanti vftram BrAtfvyasya paSUnniyuvate' (tE0 saM0 2.6.2.3). niyuvate vaSe karoti.
'ni no rayiM suBojasaM yuvasva. ni vIraM gabyamaSvyaM ca rADaH' (vA0 saM0 27.27). niyuvasva niyuhi dehi. nipUrvo yOtirdAnArTa ityuvawaH.
'vipo na dyumnA ni yuve janAnAm' (f0 8.19.33).
'raSanayA niyUya' (f0 10.70.10). niyUya=niyutya, badDvA.
'niyuvAnA niyutaH spArhavIrA' (f0 7.91.5). niyuvAnO niyuvantO saMmiSrayantO yuYjAnO.
'su maDu maDunABiyoDi' (aTarva0 5.2.3). suzWu aBito miSrayetyarTaH.
'ut pUzaRaM yuvAmahe'BISU~riva sAraTiH' (f0 6.57.6).  udyuvAmahe udyojayAmaH.
'mahInAM payo si iti darBapuYjIlAByAM navanItamudyOti' (Apa0 SrO0 10.2.6.12). udyOti udyAcCati.
'vizRoH stUpo sIti karzannivAhavanIyaM prati prastaramapAdatte nodyOti na prayOti' (Apa0 SrO0 2.3.8.5). nodyOti nodyacCati.
'agnizwe niSamayatu yadi te mana udyutam' (aTarva0 7.111.2).  udyutaM kzuBitaM vihvalaM vyAkulam. udyatamiti sAyaRaH paWati. grahavikAreRodBrAntamityevaM ca vyAKyAti.
'mekzaRena triH pradakziRamudAyOti' (kO0 sU0 2.11). UrDvamIzanmiSrayatItyAha.
'pfTaN mekzaRAByAM pradakziRamudAyuvan' (go0 gf0 4.1.4). ukto'rTaH.
'strIyoniraBiyuta enAM garBaH' (ni0 2.19). aBiyuta AmiSrIBUta iti durgaH.

'pAdAByAmeva tacCriyaM Siro'ByAyanti…pakzAByAmeva tacCriyaM Siro'ByAyuvate' (E0 brA0 4.13). aByAyuvate=aByAyuvanti miSrayanti prApnuvantItyarTaH. SriyamaBilakzya yatanta iti tu saMskftaSArmaRyakozaH. tamimamarTaM DAtvarTo na samarTayate.
'prARAnevAsya pratIcaH prati yOti' (tE0 saM0 3.4.8.5). pratiyOti niyacCati pratiruRadDi. prAtikUlyena pravartayatIti tu BawwaBAskaraH.

'vizRoH stUpo'sIti karzannivAhavanIyaM prati prastaramapAdatte nodyOti na prayOti na pratiyOti' (Apa0 SrO0 2.3.8.5). na pratiyOti na paScAtsArayatIti DartasvAmiBAzyam. na praticInaM haratIti rudradattaH. so'yaM SabdaBedo nArTaBedaH.
'pratiyuto varuRasya pASaH' (tE0 saM0 1.4.45.3). pratiyutaH pratyekaM pfTak kfta iti BawwaBAskaraH. tE0 brA0 2.6.6.4 ityatrApOdaM SrUyate. tatra pratiyutastyata iti sAyaRaH.
'ayamapItaro yoniretasmAdeva, pariyuto Bavati' (ni0 1.2.8). pariyutaH parivezwitaH. parIto jarAyuReti BAvaH.
'…kAYcanaM kalpapAdapam. palAdUrDvaM yaTA SaktyA taRqulEstUpasaMyutam' (mAtsya pu0 101.50). nArTa upena.
